artifacts/indexed_LC.pk.description: Pickled ElMTree search index over the database of compositions

artifacts/mtree_lookup.pk.description: Pickled lookup from composition (ElMD pretty formula) to the database records it appears in; without it, results carry no database ids

instance.description: Find the k compositions in the indexed database most similar to a query composition, by Element Movers Distance (ElMD).

k.description: Number of nearest neighbours to return (1-1000)

must_contain.description: Only return compositions containing all of these elements, e.g. ["Li", "O"]

must_exclude.description: Only return compositions containing none of these elements

experimental_only.description: Only return compositions found in an experimental database (needs an index built with database lookup tables; ignored otherwise)

structures_only.description: Only return compositions with an associated crystal structure (needs an index built with database lookup tables; ignored otherwise)

normalised_query.description: The query as a normalised ElMD formula (fractional amounts)

nearest_match.description: The most similar composition in the database

nearest_distance.description: Element Movers Distance from the query to the nearest match (0 = identical)

neighbours.csv.description: All neighbours, closest first: rank, formula, normalised_formula, distance, databases

dataset.description: Search for the nearest neighbours of many compositions from a CSV with a 'composition' column. Produces a CSV with one row per query and neighbour.

file.description: CSV file with a 'composition' column of chemical formulas

k.description: Number of nearest neighbours per query (1-1000)

must_contain.description: Only return compositions containing all of these elements

must_exclude.description: Only return compositions containing none of these elements

experimental_only.description: Only return compositions found in an experimental database (needs an index built with database lookup tables)

structures_only.description: Only return compositions with an associated crystal structure (needs an index built with database lookup tables)

neighbours.csv.description: One row per query and neighbour: query_row, query, rank, formula, normalised_formula, distance, databases, error
